subject: Proofing VPC storage locality & wipe verification — steps and artifacts needed
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara_kline@neurohealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@neurohealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Residency and wipe verification for upcoming audit

Hi Jonas,

We have a scheduled third-party audit for data residency and disposal controls on 2026-09-10. The auditors asked us to collect vendor evidence that demonstrates: locality of customer-controlled storage in our VPC, proofs of data wipe (tenant/snapshot-level) and the logs that show the wipe occurred (including KMS key usage).

Can Redwood provide a runbook or a short checklist of the artifacts you can produce? Specific asks from the auditor:
- A list of tenant storage endpoints and confirmation they are provisioned in the customer region (us-east-1).
- A short trace of a controlled wipe cycle (snapshot id, timestamps, and final object manifests).
- KMS key usage logs showing the deletion key operations and rotation policy.
- Any machine-readable attestations we can bundle in the audit packet.

We’d like to do a 30-minute live runthrough with your team this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sara Kline
Director, Security & Compliance
NeuroHealth Systems

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sara Kline <sara_kline@neurohealth.com>
Cc: compliance@neurohealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Residency and wipe verification for upcoming audit

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the artifacts you requested; below is a concise plan and the data artifacts we will prepare ahead of a live demo. I can run the 30-minute session tomorrow or Thursday (I included time options below).

Planned deliverables (pre-demo):
- Tenant locality report (JSON manifest + human summary) showing resource IDs and region tags (will include instance IDs, block storage handles, and S3 prefixes).
- Controlled-wipe trace: a synthetic wipe run on a staging tenant that mirrors your config. Will include snapshot IDs, object manifest before/after, and the exact API calls (encrypted audit log).
- KMS usage log excerpt: time-windowed key-usage events tied to the wipe. We will redact any unrelated customer data.
- Attestation note: short signed statement from Redwood operations confirming the steps performed and the retention policy applied.

Attachments: initial-evidence-checklist.xlsx (checklist + artifact template).

Available runthrough slots (UTC):
- 2026-09-02 15:00-15:30 UTC
- 2026-09-02 20:00-20:30 UTC

Action items for you: please confirm preferred slot and whether auditors will join the session (auditor contact already copied is fine). Also confirm whether you need time-limited read-only links to the evidence bucket.

If you’re happy, I’ll loop in our ops lead to prepare the staging wipe and the logs.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Residency and wipe verification for upcoming audit — prep tasks

Laura / Ben — Sara at NeuroHealth needs evidence for an audit (see thread below). Can you own producing the artifacts and the dry-run? Key items:

- Laura: produce the tenant locality manifest and the KMS usage slice. Need a short human summary + JSON manifest. Include resource ARN/IDs and region tags.
- Ben: orchestrate a controlled wipe on the staging tenant that mirrors NeuroHealth's config and capture: pre-wipe object manifest, snapshot id(s), wipe API call sequence, and post-wipe bucket listing.

Please use the staging tenant id: redwood-stg-neuro-2026 and follow the wipe protocol in /runbooks/vpc-wipe-protocol.

Attachments: snapshot-instructions.md (step-by-step for performing a demo wipe and producing a signed manifest).

Timeline: aim to have artifacts in the shared evidence folder by 2026-09-02 13:00 UTC so Jonas can run the 15–30 minute demo at 15:00 UTC.

Thanks — Jonas

Subject: Re: Fwd: Residency and wipe verification for upcoming audit — prep tasks

—Laura

- Can you provide an audit trail that ties the wipe to a Redwood ops user id and an email?

Jonas/Sara — we’ll join the session at the scheduled time. If you need a different slot, please advise.
